tests.name: Quick Check
tests.description: Timed check on Testing For Ions And Gases

questions.question: 1. A solution gives a lilac flame colour. What metal ion is present?
questions.correctAnswer: Potassium (K⁺) — lilac is the characteristic flame colour of potassium ions.
questions.explanation: Answer: Potassium (K⁺) — lilac is the characteristic flame colour of potassium ions.

questions.question: 2. A solution produces a brown precipitate with sodium hydroxide. Identify the cation.
questions.correctAnswer: Iron(III) (Fe³⁺) — iron(III) hydroxide is a brown precipitate.
questions.explanation: Answer: Iron(III) (Fe³⁺) — iron(III) hydroxide is a brown precipitate.
